title: Animal Museum
description: Animal Museum is a project where we selected the painting 'Maharana Bhim Singh in procession' to extract a detail from it, which would serve for the development of the museum's visual identity.

title: PAJE
description: The visual identity project was developed with the goal of conveying the core values of PAJE - protection, safety, and support - in a serious and positive manner, aligned with its commitment to guiding and transforming the lives of young people.

title: Receio
description: Receio is a project in which an interaction with the word 'Apprehension', in portuguese 'Receio', was developed, based on the meaning of the word. The entire aesthetic of the interaction was also developed according to the word's meaning.
